tasks.short: Interpret clients' artistic creations to assess functioning, needs or progress.

steps.what: Locate the authorized artwork and its actual session and client context in the clinical records system {OTHER}
Examine the actual artwork with the client's account and consider the context and limits of interpretation
Interpret the artistic creations to assess functioning, needs or progress while testing alternative explanations

tasks.design: Configure the clinical records system {OTHER} to show existing artwork references beside their actual session context. The therapist examines and interprets the work; the view does not infer diagnoses or emotions from images.
tasks.previous_blocker: Artwork references and session context may require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked clinical views can bring authorized records together.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding personal meaning without overinterpreting an image.
tasks.human_edge: Relating the client's own meaning to clinical context and uncertainty.

ambition.what: No automated assessment or larger caseload is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less record navigation; clinical interpretation and decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss functional observations in joint case review
reach.learn: Separate artistic interpretation from observed functional evidence.

evidence.claim: Native clinical record links can reduce navigation while leaving artwork interpretation with the therapist.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieving and interpreting existing artwork, not collecting it or sending a clinical recommendation. The assessment wording and its uncertainties are counted in s3; its record assembly and commitment belong to 19140 and are not credited twice.

Authorized clinicians produce client ID, session ID, date, artwork location, access restrictions and actual contextual notes. A missing or physical artwork is manually located; no planned session is treated as a completed one.
Test native clinical views first. No model reads the images. The 30% retrieval reduction applies only to repeated navigation, not client contact or interpretation.
unknowns: Whether artwork is digital, physical or mixed.
Whether native session links already exist.
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval without separating the artwork from its context?

already_counted.description: Contextual examination and artwork assessment remain fully counted.

incremental.description: Resolve broken artwork references and maintain the restricted view.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval alone drops from 15 to 10.5 points; 0.5 upkeep leaves 4. Low is no adoption if records are already linked.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather client information from case documents, observation and interviews.

steps.what: Retrieve authorized case documentation in the clinical records system {OTHER} and identify information gaps
outputs: checked existing case information and gaps

steps.what: Interview the client or family members to gather their actual accounts and clarify gaps
inputs: checked existing case information and gaps
outputs: actual attributed client and family accounts

steps.what: Observe the client directly and distinguish observed events from reported information
Capture and check the actual gathered information, attribution, dates and uncertainties in the clinical records system {OTHER}
inputs: checked existing case information and gaps
actual attributed client and family accounts
outputs: checked final information-gathering record and client destination

steps.what: Save the checked actual information-gathering record to the correct clinical record {OTHER}
inputs: checked final information-gathering record and client destination

tasks.design: Use a native clinical record view {OTHER} to retrieve the authorized case documents. Reuse client and encounter headers in its collection form; actual interview accounts, direct observations and final checking stay with the therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case information can be distributed across record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and encounter-linked forms reduce navigation and repeated headers.
tasks.still_hard: Gathering an account sensitively and recognizing what remains uncertain.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust and distinguishing observation from interpretation.

ambition.what: No additional interviews or observations are assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and repeated entry; information gathering remains personal.

reach.task: Clarify a client's information and communication preferences
reach.learn: Document attribution and disclosure limits accurately.

evidence.claim: Encounter-linked forms can reuse record headers; they do not establish what a client said or what a therapist observed.

assumptions: The therapist gathers existing documents, actual interviews and direct observations here; later interpretation and clinical recommendations are outside this collection boundary.

Existing record owners produce document ID, client ID, author and date. The therapist supplies encounter ID, actual attributed accounts, observed events and uncertainties. Missing or unstructured material is read and captured manually, not automatically inferred.
Test native retrieval and header reuse first. No ambient recording, model summary or onward send is assumed.
The final content and identity check in s4 binds a1 to that exact record and client destination. Edits require rechecking; the ordinary save remains fully counted.
unknowns: Current retrieval fragmentation and repeated header entry.
research_questions: How much collection-form time is repeated context versus actual clinical content?

already_counted.description: Capture and final verification of actual gathered information.

incremental.description: Maintain document links and collection-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual gathered-information text, attribution, client ID and record destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native retrieval at 60% gives 8 points and header reuse gives 2.85, less 0.8 upkeep: net 10.05. Low is an already consolidated system with no change.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review art therapy and related research literature.

steps.what: Search the literature database {OTHER} for an explicit art therapy, psychology or related research question and screen titles
Read the actual papers and critically review methods, results, limitations and relevance to art therapy
Write and check literature notes with exact citations, findings, limitations and unresolved questions
outputs: checked final literature note and internal folder

steps.what: Save the checked literature note in the existing professional reference folder
inputs: checked final literature note and internal folder

tasks.design: Configure native saved literature searches in the bibliographic system {OTHER} and reuse verified citation metadata in {DOCS}. Keep full-text critical reading and all clinical interpretation human; no generated summary substitutes for a paper.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches and citation copying can recur for a continuing question.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved queries and citation export reduce repeated mechanics.
tasks.still_hard: Judging weak evidence and its relevance to particular clients.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when an appealing result does not justify a clinical change.

ambition.what: Revisit one defined practice question when new literature appears.

tasks.altitude: More attention to study limitations with no change in clinical authority.

reach.task: Discuss research relevant to a shared rehabilitation question
reach.learn: Compare methods and applicability across disciplines.

evidence.claim: Bibliographic systems commonly support saved searches and citation exports.

assumptions: Boundary includes existing personal literature notes, not writing a protocol or sending practice advice. Do not add a note workflow where the therapist does none.

The database supplies title, authors, date, identifier and publication metadata. The therapist supplies the question and findings after reading actual full texts. Missing metadata is checked manually; an abstract is not a full-text review.
Try native search and citation facilities first. No model or patient data is needed. Final checking is part of normal note writing in s3, and a1 covers its exact final note and folder; edits void it.
unknowns: Whether saved searches and citation tools already cover this work.
research_questions: Can a saved query remove repeated search effort without hiding relevant alternative terms?

incremental.description: Refresh search terms and repair citation export mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact literature-note text, verified citations and internal folder checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Search falls from 25 to 12.5 and note mechanics from 14 to 11.2; gross 15.3 less 1 upkeep. No saving if those native facilities are already used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Synthesize client data into art therapy conclusions or recommendations.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual collected client information and completed assessment findings from clinical records {OTHER}
Arrange dated measures and assessment references into a comparable client timeline in the clinical records system {OTHER}
outputs: source-linked client timeline with comparability exceptions

steps.what: Analyze or synthesize the client evidence, resolve contradictions and decide justified art therapy conclusions or recommendations
inputs: source-linked client timeline with comparability exceptions

steps.what: Assemble and check the actual synthesis record, evidence links and recommendation wording in clinical records {OTHER}
outputs: checked final synthesis record and exact client destination

steps.what: Commit the checked final synthesis and recommendations to the client's clinical record {OTHER}
inputs: checked final synthesis record and exact client destination

tasks.design: Configure a native clinical timeline {OTHER} from actual dated observations and existing assessment findings. Reuse identity and source links in the synthesis form, leaving clinical conclusions, recommendation wording and complete final checking with the therapist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source retrieval, date ordering and repeated references distract from synthesis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical views can order structured observations and link their originals.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling incompatible observations and choosing appropriate therapy recommendations.
tasks.human_edge: Combining context, client goals and clinical uncertainty.

ambition.what: Review a stalled therapy goal sooner using a current evidence timeline.

tasks.altitude: Less source assembly; therapeutic decisions remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Explain evidence limits and respect each profession's scope.

evidence.claim: A native dated clinical timeline can reduce sorting and reference copying without automating clinical conclusions.

assumptions: Gathering information under 19158 and interpreting artwork under 19150 are inputs, not repeated work or repeated savings here. This boundary is cross-source synthesis and its record; treatment delivery and onward messages are outside it.

Authorized clinicians produce client ID, date, instrument ID and version, unit, value where applicable, observation author and source link. Artwork interpretations remain signed human findings. Missing fields and incompatible instruments go to manual ordering and review; no automated conversion or image interpretation.

Test native views and forms first. The timeline only sorts and displays compatible values; it does not score progress or recommend treatment. The record reduction is only reused headers and source references.

The therapist's final check inside s4 binds a1 to the complete recommendations, evidence links, client ID and destination. Any content edit requires rechecking. No additional approval layer or free save is introduced.
unknowns: Availability of dated structured measures and source references.
Actual time spent sorting rather than interpreting.
research_questions: Does a native timeline preserve incompatible measures as exceptions rather than false trends?

already_counted.description: Check the generated timeline and write and verify the final clinical record.

incremental.description: Maintain timeline field mappings and verify instrument compatibility rules.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final synthesis, recommendation wording, evidence links, client ID and clinical record destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retrieval saves 10 points, ordering 7.5, and record mechanics 3.6; gross 21.1 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is an already configured timeline or insufficient structured data, with no deployment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The therapist spends less time locating evidence and more on its meaning, retaining all clinical authority.
reach: Contribute source-linked findings to joint rehabilitation reviews.
skills_to_grow: Keep client meaning separate from image-based inference
role.ambitious_version: Revisit a stalled therapy goal earlier with a transparent evidence timeline.
